mechanism.plausibility_rationale: Tendon rupture is a well-documented adverse effect associated with fluoroquinolone antibiotics, which function by inhibiting bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV. Beta-lactam antibiotics, which inhibit penicillin-binding proteins to disrupt cell wall synthesis, do not share this mechanism of action and are not clinically associated with an increased risk of tendon rupture.
